residuals: SIGKILL terminated real native child processes, but the fixed fixture, interstice barriers and retained-state expectations are synthetic test constructs.
SIGKILL leaves the kernel, filesystem, APFS page cache and storage device alive; this is not a host crash, reboot or physical power cut.
The ten cuts occur only between returned userspace operations and provide no evidence for interruption inside pwrite, rename, fsync, F_FULLFSYNC or another entered call.
A returned fsync, F_FULLFSYNC or directory fsync is a synchronization-request fact, not a mathematical proof of survival across firmware, device or power failure.
Barrier IPC perturbs scheduling and proves a frozen ordered interstice rather than natural uninstrumented timing or instruction-cycle adjacency.
Evidence on the ordinary /private/tmp APFS volume does not model ENOSPC, EIO, constrained capacity, remount, device cache, firmware or partial physical writes.
Advisory flock coordinates cooperating processes only and does not exclude a noncooperating same-euid, root or Full-Disk-Access actor.
Named, opened, mapped and post-reap joins narrow but cannot abolish every same-euid path-spawn or namespace replacement window or attest dynamic-loader dependencies.
Userspace deadlines cannot preempt posix_spawn, an uninterruptible kernel call, or the in-process filesystem and SQLite classifier; a hard-horizon miss leaves containment unproven.
The fixed semantic oracle and JSON, CBOR and indexed-scalar agreement establish representation consistency, not historical authenticity or an external commitment.
nonclaims: This PASS is H4-D3c bounded native SIGKILL interstice and retained-state classification mechanics only.
No PASS against the superseded v1 errno-zero libproc terminator predicate is claimed.
The word crash in a test name denotes intentional SIGKILL of the exact direct publisher child, never host, kernel, VM or power loss.
An observed final-only representation before directory fsync returned is not claimed durable even when the unchanged D3b reader admitted it on the same boot.
An observed final-only representation after directory fsync returned remains same-boot local evidence and is not power-loss survival evidence.
SQLite is a checked non-authoritative container; integrity and canonical representation predicates create no truth or authority.
No retained state was adopted, repaired, retried, cleaned or converted into a production receipt by this slice.
The wider application configures com.apple.security.hypervisor and links Hypervisor.framework; neither helper has that entitlement or framework, and no Hypervisor API executed.
No producer identity, owner or lease continuity, authenticity, freshness, anti-replay or rollback resistance is established.
No H4 entry, Gate-E movement, candidate result, scientific conclusion, authority transition or successor stage is authorized by this checkpoint.
